decision_conditions: FRONT BOUNDARY WALL: Notwithstanding the drawings and details hereby approved, you are advised that this decison notice does not grant planning permisison for the replacement front boundary wall that has been erected. There is an Article 4 Direction covering the Hillmarton Conservation Area which has removed the permitted development to demolish and alter front boundary walls and therefore this replacement boundary wall requires planning permission.
